title: JENNIE Will Never Double Text a Man | Blind Date | Cosmopolitan
description: With a career that has taken her from global phenomenon to undeniable solo force, JENNIE has never stopped redefining what it means to be a superstar. The Cosmo fall cover star joins Cosmopolitan's "Blind Date" with Editor-in-Chief Willa Bennett to reflect on everything from the record-breaking success of 'Dracula' to her creative journey as a solo artist to some of her dating and friendship rules and non-negotiables.
